# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **Upcoming API adjustments**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.155 line updates HarfBuzz and refines image decoding and GLES interop support. RAW and DNG decoding are disabled, while GLES interop moves to pointer-based signatures. Review affected integrations before adopting a prerelease.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **GLES interop uses pointer-based signatures** — GLES consumers should update native interop code to use the new pointer-based signatures. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))

## Platform

- **RAW and DNG decoding disabled** — Applications that rely on bundled RAW or DNG decoding should provide an alternative image-decoding path. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## Engine

- **HarfBuzz updated to 14.4.0** — The bundled text-shaping engine advances to HarfBuzz 14.4.0. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))
